verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You stood before creation
Eternity in Your hand

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You spoke the earth into motion
My soul now to stand

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You stood before my failure
Carried the Cross for my shame

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
My sin weighed upon Your shoulders
My soul now to stand

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
So what can I say
What can I do

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
But offer this heart O God
Completely to You

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
So I'll walk upon salvation
Your Spirit alive in me

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
This life to declare Your promise
My soul now to stand

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
So I'll stand
With arms high and heart abandoned

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: In awe of the One who gave it all

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
So I'll stand
My soul Lord to You surrendered
